testcase.name: dayEndSec == StationTime.localDayEnd
invalid dates are rejected (like StationTime.dayStartUtc)
oldest first, dedupe, unknown station skipped, nothing before dayEnd + 2 h
settle window opens exactly at dayEnd + settleDelaySec (02:00 local)
never earlier than dayEnd + 60 s even if misconfigured
void deadline = dayEnd + 36 h (strictly after)
extra (replay) targets join the same queue
garbage station bytes are skipped, not thrown
scans the newest window, at or above the configured cursor, in pages
budget counts and refuses past the limit
anchor = scheduled time on a DON (scheduled <= now), DON time when the scheduled time is in the future
config.testnet.json: 02:00 local per station, hourly retries, fires >= 30 min apart and TTL below the spacing
config.anvil.json: 02:00 local per station, hourly retries, fires >= 30 min apart and TTL below the spacing
settles every due ladder, oldest first: RCSS+RJTT 10-05 and 10-06 (4 reports, 8 HTTP calls)
report bytes: v1 encoding, attester signature, validUntil = scheduled trigger time + 1500 s
validUntil comes from the cron schedule, not the DON clock, when the schedule is in the past (DON: +999 s here)
without a scheduled time it falls back to DON time (runtime.now)
simulator passes the NEXT fire time: validUntil stays <= DON time + TTL and the 02:00 gate is not opened early
